subject: how do you remove outliers from view in geom_boxplot?

messages.author: 68b661fcb57b94a9
messages.subject: how do you remove outliers from view in geom_boxplot?
parts:
ggplot2 group:

Can outliers be excluded from view using geom_boxplot?

x <- data.frame(a=factor(rep(1:10, each=50)), b=rnorm(500))

This does not seem to work:

ggplot(x,aes(a,b))+geom_boxplot(alpha=.6,colour="darkgreen",outlier.size=0)
